data.title: Unit 7 : Water, weather, wind
The water cycle
data.t2_1: Click on the water to see it rise.
data.text: The Sun heats up the water in rivers, lakes, and oceans. The heated water rises into the air.
The heated water cools and forms small water droplets.
The small droplets of water in the clouds join together and form larger droplets.
Click on the large water droplets.
The large water droplets fall to the ground in the form of rain.
Rain water fills the ponds, lakes, rivers, and oceans.
